# Trigger catalogue — sprezzature-publish

**Generated by `scripts/build_triggers.py`. Do not hand-edit.** A test asserts this file equals the generated output, so a phrase added here and nowhere else fails CI.

Markdown → static site + meta tags + favicons + site indexes + plain-language rewrite; CTA-first SEO + GEO + AEO with a FAQ built from the site's own pages.

## When this skill is the answer

**You are holding:** Markdown that has to become a site somebody else can find — or a site whose readers should do something: book, buy, install, sign up.

A phrase list cannot generalise — the ways to ask are unbounded, and a user almost never names the tool. What is bounded is the kind of thing in front of them. Match that first; the phrases below confirm a match, they do not make one.

Said without naming a tool: "put this online", "why does this look bad when shared", "SEO", "favicons", "make it readable for a wider audience", "nobody books a call", "show up in ChatGPT answers", « mon site ne convertit pas »

## When it is not

Not this one when: the question is accessibility or alt text (sprezzature-accessibility), or the speech is recorded and needs transcribing (sprezzature-audio). The exhaustive trigger catalogue is in `references/triggers.md`.
